properties.name: Dev Prayag
properties.description: Dev Prayag is the confluence of the two holy rivers, the Bhagirathi - the chief stream of the Ganges and the Alaknanda.

properties.name: Rudra Prayag
properties.description: At Rudra Prayag, the Alaknanda meets the Mandakini River. There is a temple situated above confluence named after god Shiva.

properties.name: Karn Prayag
properties.description: Karn Prayag is the location where Alaknanda river is joined by the Pindar river that originates from the Pindar glacier.

properties.name: Nand Prayag
properties.description: Nand Prayag is the second prayag in the cascade sequence of the confluences where the Nandakini river joins the main Alaknanda River.

properties.name: Vishnu Prayag
properties.description: The Alaknanda River, which originates from Satopanth glacier is joined by the Dhauliganga river.
